step1_figure.circuit_type: Two-stage CMOS op-amp with wide-swing cascode diff-amp first stage, push-pull class-AB output buffer, and indirect feedback compensation
step1_figure.description: Figure 24.29 displays a CMOS op-amp combining a cascode diff-amp first stage (M1-M4, MCM, M5, M6), a floating current-source biased push-pull class-AB output buffer (MON, MOP, MFCP, MFCN), and indirect compensation via capacitor Cc connected between the output and the source of cascode transistor M2T for improved PSRR. The circuit is tested in closed-loop inverting configuration in Figure 24.31 on page 795.

open_loop_gain_dc.description: Low-frequency open-loop voltage gain of the op-amp without external resistive loading

equation.formula: A_OLDC = A_1 * A_2 = [gmn1 * (ro_casc_n || ro_casc_p)] * [-(gmn,out + gmp,out) * (ron || rop)]
equation.explanation: Overall DC gain is the product of first-stage cascode differential amplifier gain A1 and second-stage push-pull amplifier gain A2.
equation.assumptions: No external heavy resistive load connected directly to the high-impedance internal nodes; class-AB stage drives nominal load.

sky130_expected.calculation: In SKY130 (VDD=1.8V): With cascode first stage A1 ~ 400 to 600 V/V (~52 dB) and push-pull output buffer A2 ~ -25 to -35 V/V (~30 dB), A_OLDC = 500 * 31.6 = 15,800 V/V, which equals 83.98 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Cascode loading provides high first-stage gain while class-AB stage provides moderate gain and low output impedance.

first_stage_gain.description: Voltage gain of the first-stage cascode differential amplifier (node 1)

equation.formula: A_1 = gmn1 * R_o1 = gmn1 * [ (gm2 * ro2 * ro1) || (gm4 * ro4 * ro3) ]
equation.explanation: First stage voltage gain set by input transconductance multiplied by the cascode output resistance at high-impedance node 1.
equation.assumptions: Cascode transistors operate in active saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: With gmn1 ~ 150 uA/V and cascode output resistance Ro1 ~ 3.3 MOhm, A1 ~ 500 V/V = 53.98 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Cascode configuration boosts first-stage output resistance and gain by an order of magnitude compared to simple diff-amp.

second_stage_gain.description: Unloaded voltage gain of the push-pull output buffer stage

equation.explanation: Push-pull second stage gain formed by MON and MOP working in parallel to drive the output node.
equation.assumptions: Quiescent bias current of MON/MOP is ~100 uA (10x unit sizing).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Class-AB push-pull output stage sized 10x provides low-frequency gain of ~30 dB without load.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Unity-gain frequency (gain-bandwidth product) of the open-loop op-amp

equation.explanation: Indirect feedback compensation shifts the dominant pole, establishing unity-gain frequency determined by diff-pair gm and Cc.
equation.assumptions: Cc = 240 fF connected indirectly to low-impedance source terminal of M2T.

sky130_expected.calculation: gmn1 = sqrt(2 * un*Cox * (W/L)1 * ID1) ~ 200 uA/V to 300 uA/V. fun = (250 uA/V) / (2 * pi * 240 fF) ~ 165 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Cc = 240 fF is ten times smaller than Miller compensation capacitance, allowing very high unity-gain bandwidth.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin of the open-loop amplifier at unity-gain frequency

equation.explanation: Difference between 180 degrees and the loop phase shift at the unity-gain frequency.
equation.assumptions: Phase response simulated under open-loop condition without load.

sky130_expected.calculation: Baker reports phase margin of roughly 70 degrees on page 794 for the circuit in Figure 24.29.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Indirect compensation eliminates the right-half plane zero found in standard Miller compensation, maintaining healthy phase margin.

closed_loop_bandwidth.description: Closed-loop -3dB bandwidth in inverting unity-gain configuration (noise gain = 2)

equation.explanation: For an inverting amplifier with R1=R2=10k, the feedback factor beta is 0.5, so bandwidth is fun/2.

sky130_expected.calculation: With fun ~ 150 MHz and noise gain = 2, f_3dBCL ~ 150 MHz / 2 = 75 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain-bandwidth product trades directly with closed-loop noise gain.

slew_rate_rising.description: Output rising slew rate driving 10 pF and 10 kOhm/1 kOhm load

equation.explanation: Large-signal rate of voltage increase at output when input steps negative (inverting topology).
equation.assumptions: Push-pull class-AB output device MOP turns strongly on to source current to CL = 10 pF.

sky130_expected.calculation: Peak current available from MOP during slewing is > 300 uA into 10 pF: SR_rise ~ 300 uA / 10 pF = 30 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Class-AB push-pull output buffer delivers much higher charging current than a simple single-ended source.

slew_rate_falling.description: Output falling slew rate driving 10 pF load

equation.explanation: Large-signal rate of voltage decrease at output when input steps positive (inverting topology).
equation.assumptions: Push-pull class-AB device MON turns strongly on to sink current from CL = 10 pF.

sky130_expected.calculation: Peak discharge current from MON is > 300 uA into 10 pF: SR_fall ~ 300 uA / 10 pF = 30 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: MON sinks large current from 10 pF capacitor during negative output transitions.

quiescent_power.description: Total DC quiescent power dissipation of the op-amp and bias network

equation.explanation: Total power consumed at DC quiescent state across VDD=1.8V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Bias circuit ~ 60 uA, diff-amp ~ 30 uA, cascode branches ~ 20 uA, push-pull output buffer ~ 100 uA. Total current ~ 210 uA. P_diss = 1.8V * 210 uA = 0.378 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Includes both stages and the cascode bias generator operating from 1.8V supply.

step3_testbench.description: Simulation testbench for the CMOS op-amp with output buffer (Fig. 24.29 & Fig. 24.31). Characterizes DC operating point, open-loop frequency response (gain, unity-gain frequency, phase margin), closed-loop frequency response, and transient pulse response (slewing and settling times driving 10k/10pF load).
